name: Prismatic Aura
body:
School evocation [light]; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged (D)

You are surrounded by an aura of scintillating colors.

This shimmering aura grants you concealment and any creature that hits you with a non-reach melee weapon or a melee natural weapon is subject to a random prismatic effect. Roll on the prismatic spray table. The aura cannot generate two effects at once, so reroll any 8s rolled. Each time an effect is expended, that color dissipates from the aura and must be re-rolled if rolled on the table on future rounds. Once all the colors have been used, the spell ends. An attacker is entitled to the applicable saves, and spell resistance applies.
